content.title: Browse published books by genre
content.description: Any visitor browses the published-books showcase by starting from the full catalog or a genre page, sees total catalog and per-genre counts, views the total number of matching books independent of page size, switches between defined sort orders and display counts, and can toggle grid and list layouts while still seeing the same books; this remains a showcase-only experience with no price, basket, or checkout behavior.
content.summary: Browse the showcase catalog by genre.
content.value: Lets readers explore Fernwood Press titles and discover books within genres.
criteria: `/books` states the total catalog size as `<total> books published through Fernwood Press so far.`
`/books` lists every genre with the number of titles in it, and each genre name links to that genre’s listing page.
A genre listing shows `<total> book(s) found`, counting every genre match rather than only the books currently displayed on the page.
The sort control offers `Title (A-Z)` as the default and `Rating (high to low)`, and rating sort reorders tiles highest-rating first.
The `Show` control offers 6, 12, and 20 per page; the default is 20, and choosing 6 renders exactly six tiles while the found count stays unchanged.
`Grid view` and `List view` show the same books.
Every book tile shows a cover image, the title as a link, the author, `Rating: <n>`, and the format.
A genre that does not exist returns a 404 and shows `No books found in this genre.`
